context.body: Gospel, Israel, and shared life · Romans 8:1–11
context.label: Gospel, Israel, and shared life

observations.body: Life in the Spirit answers condemnation and death. There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit. But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.
observations.label: Life in the Spirit answers condemnation and death

payload.posture: Read Romans 8:1–11 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states life in the Spirit answers condemnation and death. There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit. But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
